Retrieving his blade from the still smoking remains Sha'fu limped into the small courtyard that bore host to the Heart of Gaea, the air was lighter here, sweeter, though still tainted by the smoke billowing in from the corridor. Approaching the tree Sha'fu could hear a strange[ ringing](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=X7t--zPZdic), perhaps a remnant of Hom's power. With his good arm the warrior reached up and plucked a fruit from the tree; sinking his teeth into its soft, glowing flesh. As he swallowed the fruit his body was filled with a great heat which caused him to drop to his knees, he could feel his muscles rippling and vibrating beneath his flesh as the Heart of Gaea's magic coursed through his body. After a few moments the heat passed and Sha'fu rose to his feet "Hom's gift is indeed powerful" he thought to himself as he assessed his now healed arm and soon after removed his eyepatch and found to his delight that it too had been healed.

"Praise Hom!" Sha'fu cried in joy "And praise Zille for sending me to this blessed place" Remembering his quest, the warrior turned to face the tree and plucked a second fruit before reclining against the tree to await his Goddess's Return.
